lines.text: He's too cheap to buy lunch.

data.define: Describes a stingy person; it can also mean low quality.

example.text: He's too cheap to buy lunch.

misuse.text: Don't call grandma 'cheap' for using coupons.

data.l1_hook: Он никогда не платит за обед, «cheap»!

native.tip: “cheap” = жадный; скупой; дешёвый. Пример: “He's too cheap to buy lunch.”
native.caption:
Что значит «cheap»?
“cheap” = жадный; скупой; дешёвый.
Пример: “He's too cheap to buy lunch.” (Он слишком «cheap», чтобы купить обед.)
